profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Ford Credit

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and employed software integrations between React, Java backend API, and SQL server instance
•	Researched, designed, and implemented a scalable content management system (CMS) used for repair information collection, extraction, analysis, and retrieval
•	Designed, executed, and maintained Java Spring RESTful API to provide an interface between business logic, internal web applications, and tooling
•	Architected data pipelines for interdepartmental asset delivery and reporting purposes

positions.title: Product Development Content Specialist
positions.description:
• Contributed as a subject matter expert to the ideation and creation of automotive diagnostic products.
•	Devised content coverage reporting solutions; reported technologies for managerial and departmental review

positions.title: Quality Control Specialist
positions.description:
• Performed quality control assessment for SureTrack Expert Information article content
•	Content used worldwide in industry-leading advanced automotive diagnostic product lines consisting of web services and over 15 handheld platforms
